value: **Scientific Inquiry & Explanatory Modeling**: Focuses on student practices of generating, testing, evaluating, and iteratively revising explanatory scientific models using empirical evidence. Evidence: "Drawing on multimodal microanalysis of interaction, we examine how undergraduate physics students use representational gesture to make sense of instants while modeling energy dynamics."
